name: accidental-flat
description: A musical flat with a long stem and open lower bowl.
useCase: Apply a flat accidental to lower a written pitch by one semitone.
misuse: Use the flat sign only for musical pitch, with a readable label when needed.

16.reason: The long stem and broad lower bowl retain a clear opening at text size.

24.reason: The complete stem and curved bowl keep the flat sign narrow and open.
